resources.string: Sidr can open the wallpaper picker so you can personalise your home screen. This is optional — the launcher works fully without it, and you can change your mind any time.

Voice input lets you speak commands instead of typing. The launcher only listens while you tap the mic, never records in the background, and prefers on-device recognition. It\'s optional — typing always works without it.

Reading your calendar lets Sidr suggest the right thing at the right time, like nudging you toward an upcoming event. Sidr only checks whether something is coming up soon — it never stores event titles, times, or details. It\'s optional — suggestions work fine without it, and you can change your mind any time.

Using your location lets Sidr surface nearby-relevant actions, like suggesting a maps app when you\'re out and about. Sidr only checks whether a recent location fix exists — it never stores or sends your coordinates. It\'s optional — suggestions work fine without it, and you can change your mind any time.

Using your device location lets Sidr compute accurate prayer times for where you are, rounded to about a kilometre before it\'s ever stored. Your coordinates stay on this device — they are never sent anywhere or logged. It\'s entirely optional: picking a city from the list works without this permission, and you can change your mind any time.
